notes.title: Release Date Set - Coming July 31st!!!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="Cs71wz8hdAM;full"][/previewyoutube]


Celebrating the release date for my first game! FOOS started as a simple practice project to learn about Godot and expanded into a way to learn about publishing on Steam, but over time has morphed into a major passion project that I'm very happy to have this opportunity to share. 



It's come a long way since the early days, 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45177120/3b352bf4eea70a5796b41dfc070937df5510c02d.png"]

and the story introduced in FOOS has much further to go throughout future projects. 



I hope you enjoy! 



- Fletcher
